The '''Site Information''' panel is where you can view information about a website's connection security and identity.

== Connection security ==
A {for not fx149}padlock icon [[Image:IG lock]]{/for}{for fx149}shield icon [[Image:IG trust icon active]]{/for} in the address bar will indicate whether the connection to the website is fully secure. For more information, click the {for not fx149}padlock{/for}{for fx149}shield{/for} to open the ''Site Information'' panel. This panel shows you whether the current connection is classified as secure.
;{for not fx149}[[Image:Fx140SiteInfoPanel]]{/for}{for fx149}[[Image:Fx149SiteInfoPanel]]{/for}
Click the Connection entry {for not fx149}in{/for}{for fx149}at the top of{/for} the ''Site Information'' panel to view the {for not fx149}''Connection Security''{/for}{for fx149}''Connection protections''{/for} panel. This is where you can learn more about connection security, such as the issuer of a certificate for a secure connection and – if it is made available – the website's owner, or disable the blocking of insecure content on a site. This panel also includes a {for not fx149}{button More information}{/for}{for fx149}{button More site information}{/for} button that will open the [[View site information with Page Info|Page Info window]] {menu Security} tab for the website.
;{for fx149}[[Image:Fx149ConnectionProtection]]{/for}
See [[How do I tell if my connection to a website is secure?]] to learn more about connection security. The [[Mixed content blocking in Firefox]] article tells you about Firefox's mixed content blocking security feature.
{note}'''Note:''' If you have set any special permissions for the website, you will also see a Permissions icon [[Image:IG permissions]] in the address bar. Click this icon to view or adjust those permissions. If you don't see a Permissions icon or to edit other permissions, the [[View site information with Page Info|Page Info window]] includes a {menu Permissions} tab with a list of available permission settings for the website. To learn more, see [[Site Permissions panel]].{/note}
